purpose: Every creature-loot drop visible in the supplied gameplay footage, with the kills around it, as evidence for creature_loot (AGENTS.md evidence-bounded reconstruction). Audit item SEG3-CREATURE-LOOT (research/20260926-segment3-audit/gaps.json).
method: Final week (7Lrst9SG3pk, 8VXeKzGUv0c, Ycxm8Pa1-v4; one player's continuous session and one other player, both Denzil's Caldera boot camp then Concordia Wilderness, recorded the week of 2009-02-26): the frame-by-frame transcripts of segments A3-A5, B1-B3 and C1-C2 made 2026-09-13 (the E1 extract behind docs/evidence/bootcamp-d11-footage-events.json) and their verification pass, recovered from the rescued session logs (sources.transcripts). Every 'You received ...' line other than credits and prestige, every corpse and container window, every kill-reward line and every edit cut was taken from them.

Kill counting: a credited kill is a 'You received N credits' kill line (the kill credit, KillRewardRules 5 x level); XP-only lines without credits are listed as uncredited and not counted. Chat that becomes visible across an edit cut is its own window (revealed_across_cut): its kills and drops are both counted, because the chat window shows both.

Pravus (A4udsM0rcLo, uploaded 2009-01-21 by the same Zorlac whose Zorlac Ripslayer plays Ycxm8Pa1-v4 and Pravus): read by this batch from 1/4 fps crops of the chat window (ffmpeg in an alpine:3.20 container, crop 345x170 at 0,28 of the 1152x720 copy, tiled 3x5). A squad of three: drops go to one member ('X looted'), with need/greed rolls. Creature identity is never in the chat, so Pravus supplies ammunition types and stack sizes only.

Item identities: the English physicalentityclassnamelanguage (15,967 rows) and the world's itemtemplate_itemclass from the 1.16.5.0 client, decoded statically (decode_literal_table.py, never executed).

sources.transcripts_note: The committed transcripts and the retained frames (research/20260913-bootcamp/footage/) are not on this machine. A4 and C1 recovered copies are byte-identical to the committed transcripts; the others are working copies from the same session whose hashes differ, and every event cited from them agrees with the curated footage-events file wherever that file carries it (A4-43, A5-18, B1-028).

kill_windows.note: Camp defence; nothing looted on camera (the corpses are looted inside the 480.5 cut, KW03).
Death at 462.0 and hospital respawn at 469.8; nothing looted.
Two '71 XP / 10 credits' pairs plus a leading '10 credits' line whose XP line has scrolled out of the chat window: three kills (the third inferred from the lone credit line).
The 143 XP / 50 credits line of the same reveal is the boss (Tizzik Gi) kill and is not counted.
A 17 XP line without credits (B1-025) is not a credited kill.
A lone '10 credits' line at the top of the chat after the 14.067 cut; no loot line follows it.
One continuous clip (C1 0-86 and C2 80.5-165.7 overlap at 80.5-86; the overlapping events are counted once). XP-only lines C1-021, C1-030, C1-038 carry no credits.
The 44 XP line without credits and its Thrax Heart (F38) are not a credited boargar kill.

thrax_skull.reading: a lower bound of the per-corpse drop chance: a corpse the player never opened is counted as a kill without a skull. The four corpse windows whose whole contents are on screen show a skull on three.

thrax_infantry_trainee.reading: consistent with the Initiate intervals; too few kills for a separate rate

ammo_types.reading: All five standard-grade weapon ammunition classes of the client drop (the five Ammo_*_1_Standard_Grade classes named as ammo_class_id by weaponclass rows; Spore Micromech 7632 is named by none and is a crafting resource). Stack size ranges differ by type; no type is heavily favoured (5/4/5/2/3).

hypotheses.claim: a creature drops ammunition of the killer's equipped weapon
hypotheses.evidence: 5 of the 7 ammunition drops whose receiver's weapon is known are a type that weapon cannot fire: power cells and rockets to a Shinobi Rifle, an AccuMax Shotgun and a Teleract Rifle, all three of which fire Standard Grade Cartridges (their own tooltips and the client weaponclass rows). F07 is corroborated by the rifle's reserve, which did not grow by the 117 cells.

hypotheses.claim: a creature's ammunition drop is one stack of any of the five standard-grade weapon ammunition types, independent of the killer's weapon
hypotheses.evidence: 19 ammunition drops across the Thrax Infantry Initiate, the Thrax Infantry Trainee and the Pravus squad kills cover all five types; 2 of 7 attributable drops match the weapon, against 1.4 expected under a uniform type.

hypotheses.claim: Thrax infantry drop Thrax Skull junk (quantity 1)
hypotheses.evidence: 22 of 42 credited Initiate kills; 3 of 4 Trainee kills; every line reads 1.

implementation.rows: creature_loot 199400-199418; see the manifest rows for field tiers
implementation.removed: creature_loot 1, 8, 15 (the emulator's 12% 1-35 Standard Grade Cartridges row on creatures 3, 198507, 198513): contradicted by every observed stack (33-281, and the type varies)
implementation.kept: creature_loot 2-7, 9-14, 16-21 (emulator Motor Assist armour 0.5% and Class I Basic Med Pack 5%, analogues under OD-96): the footage neither confirms nor contradicts them (1 Motor Assist piece in 42 Initiate kills, 0 med packs; P(0 | 5%, 42) = 0.12)

fallback.behaviour: a creature without creature_loot rows drops 3 Standard Grade Cartridges (template 28) on a coin flip
fallback.counterpart: none original: InfiniteRasa's emulator stand-in. The ledger shows real corpses dropping creature-specific junk, any standard-grade ammunition (33-281 a stack), schematics and gear.
